name: @pipeworx/mcp-slack_connect

tools.name: slack_list_channels
tools.description: List channels in the Slack workspace. Returns channel names, IDs, and metadata.

limit.description: Max number of channels to return (default 100, max 1000)

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for next page of results

types.description: Comma-separated channel types: public_channel, private_channel, mpim, im (default "public_channel")

tools.name: slack_channel_history
tools.description: Get message history from a Slack channel. Bot auto-joins the channel if needed.

limit.description: Max number of messages to return (default 20, max 1000)

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for next page of results

oldest.description: Only messages after this Unix timestamp

latest.description: Only messages before this Unix timestamp

tools.name: slack_send_message
tools.description: Send a message to a Slack channel. Bot auto-joins the channel if needed.

channel.description: Channel ID to send the message to

thread_ts.description: Thread timestamp to reply in a thread (optional)

tools.name: slack_list_users
tools.description: List users in the Slack workspace. Returns user profiles, IDs, and status.

limit.description: Max number of users to return (default 100, max 1000)

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for next page of results

tools.name: slack_join_channel
tools.description: Join a public Slack channel so the bot can read history and post messages.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-slack_connect forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the slack_connect pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
